TSAAT Build Dependency Inventory
================================

This file lists the dependencies required to compile this codebase.
Transitive npm dependencies are resolved from package-lock.json during install.

System dependencies (required)
------------------------------
1. Windows PowerShell 5.1+ (or PowerShell 7+)
2. Node.js >= 18.17.0
3. npm >= 8.0.0

Project dependencies (npm runtime)
----------------------------------
- clsx ^2.1.1
- next ^14.2.35
- papaparse ^5.5.3
- pdf-lib ^1.17.1
- puppeteer-core ^24.37.5
- react 18.2.0
- react-dom 18.2.0
- react-is ^18.2.0
- recharts ^3.7.0
- three ^0.181.2
- zod ^4.3.6

Project dependencies (npm development/build)
-------------------------------------------
- @types/node 20.11.30
- @types/papaparse ^5.5.2
- @types/react 18.2.79
- @types/react-dom 18.2.25
- @types/three ^0.181.0
- @vitest/coverage-v8 ^4.0.18
- autoprefixer ^10.4.24
- eslint 8.57.0
- eslint-config-next ^14.2.35
- postcss ^8.5.6
- tailwindcss 3.4.17
- tsx ^4.21.0
- typescript ^5.9.3
- vitest ^4.0.18

Compilation order used by the Windows script
---------------------------------------------
Implemented by both `Dependencies\compile.ps1` and `Dependencies\compile.cmd`.

1. Verify Node.js and npm versions.
2. Install npm dependencies from lockfile (`npm ci --legacy-peer-deps`).
3. Compile source code (`npm run build`).
